jobs.title: Campus Security Officer - Night & Weekend Shifts
jobs.company: The Chronicle Of Higher Education, Inc.
jobs.description:
Department: Police Salary: Commensurate with Experience/Education

Description: Provides physical security for a university building. Pursuant to the State of Texas Executive Order No. GA‑48, this position researches, works on, or has access to critical infrastructure and requires the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the university infrastructure.

The position requires personnel to be routinely reviewed to determine whether a criminal history or continuous connections to a foreign adversary might prevent the employee from maintaining the security or integrity of the infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Unlocks and locks doors and checks all floors for unsecured doors.
  • Monitors entry into the building and maintains sign‑in/out log.
  • Monitors security cameras and radio traffic; alerts proper personnel of camera malfunctions.
  • Answers the telephone and greets visitors; provides information and directions.
  • Provides immediate contact with the university's police department in case of an emergency; prepares incident reports.
  • May accept parcel packages and deliver them to designated floors or staff.
  • May monitor and control entry into a gated parking lot.
  • Patrols assigned areas to check for criminal activity, rule violations, and irregularities.
  • Performs other job‑related duties assigned.
M&Q: Requires a basic knowledge of grammar, spelling, punctuation, and simple mathematical functions such as percentages and ratios. This may normally be acquired through a high school diploma or GED.

No experience is required.

Requires a valid Texas Driver's License.

Requirements

  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, and overtime assignments.
  • Must be proficient with using a computer and Microsoft Office suite.
  • Must pass a Criminal History and valid TX Driver’s License check prior to an interview.
  • Must pass Background Investigation prior to employment.
  • Must pass a pre‑employment drug screening.
UHPD requires all applicants to complete the criminal history fields on their application. Applicants with incomplete criminal history fields will not be considered for a position.

Required information includes

  • DOB
  • Driver’s license
  • Last 4 digits of SSN
Veterans are strongly encouraged to apply and will receive preference in employment over other applicants for the same position who do not have a greater qualification. Military experience will only be considered if it includes Military Police or Security‑related responsibilities in your job functions. (Please attach a copy of your DD‑214.)

Salary will be based on years of experience.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (accrual increases with service years)
  • Sick leave accrual
  • Comprehensive free medical coverage for employees (premiums apply for family members)
  • Great optional benefits to enhance your medical coverage
  • Many on‑campus / off‑campus employee perks

Physical & Environmental Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job and are not meant to be all inclusive. While performing this job the staff member shall:

Environmental: The employee may be exposed to inclement weather conditions and has extensive public contact with student, faculty, and staff.

Employees are required to work various assigned shifts, including days, evenings, nights, and weekends, and may be required to remain at their post for an additional shift. All staff are essential personnel and are required to report to work during inclement weather.

Physical: Primary functions require sufficient physical ability to work in a law‑enforcement setting and an office setting; restrain or subdue individuals; walk, stand, sit, or run for extended periods of time; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; occasionally climb and balance; ability to operate and use specialized law‑enforcement tools and equipment.

All positions at the University of Houston‑System are security‑sensitive and will require a criminal history check.

The University of Houston System and its universities are Equal Opportunity Institutions. Everyone is encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)
jobs.description:
Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer – West Houston (77024)

Join Our Team – Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security Officer Needed

Retail Property

Position: Exterior Vehicle Patrol Security OfficerSchedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours Weekly

  • Saturday–Sunday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • Monday–Tuesday: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM
  • Wednesday–Thursday: Off
  • Friday: 3:00 PM–11:00 PM
  • Pay Rate: $15.50-$16.00 (Depending on experience)

United Protective Services is seeking a professional, dependable, and customer-focused Security Officer to provide exterior vehicle patrol coverage at a retail property.

This is an active patrol position requiring the officer to operate a company/client patrol vehicle, maintain a visible security presence, and regularly work outdoors in varying weather conditions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine vehicle patrols throughout the property, parking lots, and surrounding exterior areas.
  • Maintain a visible and proactive security presence to deter theft, vandalism, trespassing, and unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor parking areas, storefronts, exterior access points, and other designated areas.
  • Identify and report suspicious activity, safety hazards, property damage, and maintenance concerns.
  • Professionally interact with tenants, customers, vendors, employees, and Property Management.
  • Respond promptly to security concerns, disturbances, and incidents.
  • Complete accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs), incident reports, and patrol documentation.
  • Safely operate the assigned patrol vehicle and comply with all company and property driving requirements.

Qualifications

  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record required.
  • Must reside within approximately 20 miles of ZIP Code 77024.
  • Scheduling flexibility is required, including the ability to assist with coverage outside the regular schedule when operationally necessary.
  • Previous security experience preferred.
  • Must be comfortable operating a patrol vehicle for extended periods.
  • Must be willing and able to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Professional appearance, attitude, and demeanor.
  • Ability to remain alert, observant, and proactive throughout the shift.
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality are required.
  • Ability to complete written and electronic security reports accurately.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is dependable, flexible, observant, professional, and customer-service oriented. Candidates should be comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and maintaining situational awareness while conducting continuous exterior patrols.

Because this position involves vehicle patrol and exterior security duties, applicants must be comfortable spending a significant portion of their shift driving, entering and exiting the patrol vehicle, and working outdoors in the elements.

Why Join United Protective Services?

  • Full-time, 40-hour weekly schedule.
  • Consistent permanent assignment.
  • Company/client patrol vehicle provided while on duty.
  • Stable work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Support from an established security management team.

If you are dependable, flexible, professional, live within the required area, and are comfortable performing active exterior vehicle patrols, we encourage you to apply.
